RequireEquipped.Name: Benefits require equipped gear
RequireEquipped.Hint: A spellheart's benefits only apply while its armor is worn or its weapon or shield is held. Turn off to apply them whenever the spellheart is affixed.

MaxAffixes.Name: Spellhearts per item
MaxAffixes.Hint: How many spellhearts (or talismans) one item can carry. The rules allow one.

TalismanicSage.Name: Talismanic Sage adds a slot
TalismanicSage.Hint: Characters with the Talismanic Sage feat can affix one more item to each piece of gear.

ChatMessages.Name: Post affix messages to chat
ChatMessages.Hint: Post a chat message when a spellheart is affixed or detached.

ShowPanel.Name: Show benefit panel in inventory
ShowPanel.Hint: Show the affixed spellhearts and their benefits under each armor and weapon in the character sheet inventory.

Picker.Title: Affix {name}
Picker.Prompt: Choose the armor or weapon to affix {name} to.
Picker.ActivityNote: Affixing a spellheart takes 10 minutes (Affix a Spellheart).

Confirm.Title: Check the material
Confirm.Metal: This spellheart must be affixed to metal armor. Is {host} made of metal?
Confirm.NonMetal: This spellheart must be affixed to non-metal armor. Is {host} free of metal?

Panel.MissingHint: This benefit's effect was removed from the character. Re-apply it to restore the benefit.
Panel.Situational: Applies only in some situations; PF2e checks this when you roll.
Panel.NoAutomation: No automated benefit found for this spellheart. Check its description.

Info.HostRemoved: {name} was detached because the item it was affixed to is gone.

Warn.DifferentActor: The spellheart and the item must belong to the same character.
Warn.NotForWeapon: {name} can't be affixed to a weapon.
Warn.NotForShield: {name} can't be affixed to a shield.
Warn.WrongGroup: {host} is not the right kind of weapon.
Warn.NoSlots: {host} already has the maximum number of affixed items ({limit}).
Warn.NoValidHosts: {name} has nothing it can be affixed to.
